issues.reason: The reviewer's own gap concedes there is no licensed form for a quantity NP filling an object role, and (Measure sk_add_1 amount (ParticleFromNormal 215000000 21500000) dollar) is true of the sentence, well-typed (an event Measure, as with `duration`) and asserts nothing extra — the scale-word rule presupposes a stated dimension, so this is graceful improvisation in gap territory, not a defect.

gaps_confirmed: a measure phrase as a verb's direct object ('add $215 million to its revenue') — Measure attaches to an entity or an event's duration, with no form for a quantity NP in an object role

a descriptive temporal NP as an event's Time ('in the first full year after the acquisition') — Time takes structured calendar terms or deictic constants, and Ordinal's scale slot has no reading for a period
a proper-noun modifier on a common-noun head ('the PracticeWorks deal') — compound fusion is barred for proper nouns and no attachment head is given
new_gaps: an attitude seal nested inside another attitude's seal ('said ... is expected to ...'): nothing inside a seal can carry a truth value, so the impersonal-attitude rule's confidence adjustments (and any hedge) are unexpressible on the inner attitude
